paragraphs.text: Narjabul is a city on the great island of Gulmany , part of the Terisian Isles on modern day Dominaria .
Narjabul lies on the east coast of Gulmany , not very far from the northern edge of Kovria . The city celebrates mid-summer with a festival.

In 3245 AR , Xantcha and Urza came to Narjabul to plant anti- sleeper agent traps. The streets were crowded with mid-summer activity and they were accosted by a trio of young, drunk men, who tried to steal Urza's purse and harassed Xantcha. When she fought back, the youth called for help, drawing the crowd's attention and setting a local wizard upon her. Xantcha resorted to shouting Urza's name for help, a dangerous thing to do given the known presence of Gix on Gulmany . Urza planeswalked them both away before the situation could escalate any further.
